    For a stack of `n_layers` layers on a substrate of index n_sub, viewed from
    the air side, the input admittance must equal n_ambient.  Working from the
    substrate outward, each layer's optical thickness (nd) is chosen so that the
    admittance it presents to the next outer layer equals the desired target,
    then the layer material (L or H) is the one that can realize that
    admittance (|Y| <= n_layer).  The physical thickness is d = nd / n_layer.

    mats = []
